description: Issue #195: one non-string ENTRY refuses the whole declaration. A nested array is the realistic slip — argv-style `["bin/verify-all"]` written inside a list of command strings — and it is the one a permissive loader hides best: `String(["bin/verify-all"])` is "bin/verify-all", so coercing would appear to work until an entry with two elements silently became one comma-joined command that no shell would run. Refused whole rather than per entry, and before an issue is read, because a verification set that runs all but one of its steps is the shape of green this Issue is about (`load_error` / exit 6).

error_details_include: profile.integration_baseline must be an array of strings
